_comment: Frozen backlog for ctest_label_exclusion_guard.py. Each suite here is registered ONLY behind a ctest label that both the required `macos` gate (-LE) and the diff-coverage lane (--label-exclude) drop, so its cases are enforced by nothing and the lines it exercises report as uncovered. Every entry below predates the guard and was a deliberate, comment-documented exclusion at its registration site -- not an accident. They are frozen rather than repaired because whether a suite can be split is a per-suite judgement (a `~[slow]` spec that matches no case discovers nothing), and because the value of this guard is stopping the population from growing, which it does from the day it lands. Same idiom as hotspot_size_guard.json. An entry whose target is no longer blind is REMOVED, not left to rot: the guard fails on a stale exemption, because a ledger of dead exemptions is the same silent rot this guard exists to catch. To clear an entry, apply the TEST_SPEC split the guard's failure text prints and delete the line here in the same change.

allow.reason: Every scenario waits on filesystem mtime resolution (~1s each). Splitting needs a per-case audit of which assertions actually need the sleep.
Every scenario waits on filesystem mtime resolution (~1s each). Splitting needs a per-case audit of which assertions actually need the sleep.
ScriptedUiSession reload cases sleep on file-watcher debounce plus mtime resolution. Splitting needs a per-case audit of which assertions need a real reload.

SeqLock/TripleBuffer hammer cases run a writer plus readers for 500 ms each. The registration reasons that sanitizers.yml re-covers the code -- true, but that lane is advisory and feeds no coverage, which is the gap this guard names.
N-thread race smoke. Same sanitizers.yml reasoning as pulp-test-sync, and the same hole: an advisory lane does not block a merge.
Timer hammer and destroy-while-dispatched cases exercise message-loop pacing (~0.3-1.5 s each). Splitting needs a per-case audit of which cases need real pacing.
Live-GPU replay proof, environment-sensitive on ephemeral macOS CI VMs. Deliberately kept out of the required and merge-group lanes; a split would need a non-GPU subset to exist first.

Calls StandaloneApp::start(), which opens the real audio device; a virtual/default device can block inside AudioComponentInstanceNew. Real-hardware acceptance cannot run on the required gate at all, so exclusion is the design rather than an oversight.
Drives the one system pointer and is labelled human-input. There is no fast subset to split off; exclusion is the design.
Dedicated scaling benchmark, built only under PULP_BENCHMARK. Carries timing measurements rather than a correctness contract the required gate would enforce.
Dedicated layout benchmark. Carries timing and allocation measurements rather than a correctness contract the required gate would enforce.
Dedicated oscillator benchmark, built only under PULP_BENCHMARK.
Dedicated adapter-cost benchmark, built only under PULP_BENCHMARK. Explicitly advisory: reports medians with no timing budget.
Dedicated prepare-time benchmark, built only under PULP_BENCHMARK. Explicitly advisory: reports evidence with no timing threshold.
